summary: Established a robust architectural governance framework, including AST-based parsing, transactional indexing for real-time knowledge graph evolution, and information-theoretic telemetry using KL divergence to detect behavioral drift. These implementations prioritize verifiable structural outputs and system determinism over theoretical exploration, ensuring high-fidelity knowledge synthesis and stability.
key_learnings: AST-based parsing and model pinning ensure system determinism, while DSR-based SRS models provide superior scalability.
Coupling index updates to atomic patch operations prevents index drift and fragmentation.
Information theory (KL divergence) provides a robust mathematical foundation for identifying systemic anomalies and distinguishing refactoring from degradation.
Architectural metrics are most effective when tracking specific, verifiable outputs rather than abstract progress.
